text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of her first Classic race, the Satsuki Sho, Gold Ship is beside herself. Apparently, she's furious a race named after May on the old Japanese calendar would take place in April.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a wildly unexpected turn, Gold Ship swears to win the Satsuki Sho and rename it "Uzuki Sho" for April when she does.
